_note: Declared footprints for building art (F1) — the authority for NEW art. A name maps to its footprint as a bare [w, h] (footRoom 0) or {footprint, footRoom}; e.g. "windmill": {"footprint": [1, 3], "footRoom": 24}. Anything absent here (and from the compiled + sheet manifests) only compiles when its canvas is one of the legacy squares (128/256/384/512²) — otherwise the compiler fails and names this file. Keys starting with _ are notes. F5 (#273) non-square art: a rectangle's name is <w>x<h> with w along grid x and h along grid y, so a building whose LONG side runs isometrically lower-left → upper-right is 1x2 / 1x3 / 2x4 — and its #274 mirror (the same drawing turned to the other axis, `<name>_r`) is 2x1 / 3x1 / 4x2. "mirror": true marks a base name whose mirrored orientation was measured to be usable: the world's light is upper-LEFT (every shipped master's SW wall is 1.2–1.8× its SE wall — check with `node tools/normalize-building-art.mjs --lighting-check <file>`), so a mirror flips it. All five pairs below ship BOTH orientations as real art, so nothing needs mirroring at draw time; the flag tells #275 the mirror is faithful. Exception measured, not hidden: `shops_1x3`'s raw drawing is lit from the RIGHT (ratio 0.48) and `shops_1x3_r` is the one that matches the house convention (2.05) — same geometry, opposite painted light.
